    Text.Remove(

  #"Cleaned address" = Table.TransformColumns(

  #"Removed other columns" = Table.SelectColumns(#"Cleaned address", {"break_even_fee", "owner_id", "agreement_type", "segment", "monthly_salaries", "school_status", "updated_at", "created_at", "contract_start_date", "ecd_code", "school_commencement_date", "address", "number_of_classrooms", "name", "city_id", "region_id", "school_id", "id", "capacity"}),

  Replace_Status_Active = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Removed columns", "Active", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
  Replace_Status_NotActive = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_Active, "Not 301220000", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
